title: Replace fixed 50-item aggregate walls with Firestore cursor pagination (REQ-005 §8)
author: CheungHiuTung-2526 <250016155@stu.vtc.edu.hk>

cases: family documents scale past legacy 50 cap with cursor pagination and duplicate guards
shared inputs scale past legacy 50 wall with cursor pagination and boundary checks
concerns scale past legacy 200 aggregate wall with cursor pagination and timeline limit enforcement

counterexampleVerification.description: Mutating prepareChange by setting full = false intentionally breaks the 200 event timeline limit guard
counterexampleVerification.observedResult: tests/firestore-cursor-pagination.test.ts failed with AssertionError: Missing expected rejection on 201st append (RED)
counterexampleVerification.restorationResult: Restored full = value.eventCount >= CONCERN_EVENT_LIMIT returns all suites to 3/3 PASS (GREEN)

retainedSafetyGuards: Growth report duplication check (report_exists) preserved with indexed where('status', '==', 'active').where('kind', '==', 'growth_report') queries
Single concern event timeline limit (CONCERN_EVENT_LIMIT = 200) strictly enforced at 201st append with concern_history_requires_review (400)
Archive action confirmed and permitted at CONCERN_EVENT_LIMIT to allow lifecycle closure
Cross-child and malformed cursor rejection strictly enforced (invalid_input 400)
Deterministic keyset pagination ordering preserved with tie-breaking
eliminatedAggregateWalls: Eliminated 50 active family documents creation limit (document_limit)
Eliminated 50 shared inputs creation capacity limit (inputs_capacity)
Eliminated 200 total child concerns creation and listing limit (concern_history_requires_review)
notRun: Production Firestore load testing / emulator stress testing
Live Gemini Live model API integration
Mobile app native UI / React Native device execution
